headline: Referred Burlington Forward resolution to four committees 7-5 after a motion to table failed
summary: The council held a long public forum on a proposed Burlington Forward resolution, then took up a consent agenda with personnel, contract, and property items. It approved entertainment permits, a parking license agreement, and a sewer ordinance, then referred the Burlington Forward resolution to committees after rejecting motions to table it and to divide the question.
decisions: A motion to extend the public forum to allow all speakers to comment failed 6-6.
Adopted the consent agenda and took the actions indicated.
Suspended the rules to complete the consent and deliberative agendas, passing 11-1.
Approved the 2026-2027 Indoor Entertainment Permit Application for Big Lake Recording Company LLC, 70 South Winooski Avenue, Suite 2B.
Approved the one day special event outdoor entertainment permit for Queen City Printers, Inc., 699 & 701 Pine Street Parking Lot, September 11, 2026, Art Hop Event.
Approved the License Agreement Application for Omega Electric Co. at 270-274 College Street for two parking stalls.
Adopted the Industrial Pollution Prevention Program Update, BCO Chapter 26, as amended by the Ordinance Committee.
A motion to table the Burlington Forward resolution failed 5-7.
A motion to divide the question on the Burlington Forward resolution, separating Article 5, failed 4-8.
Referred the Burlington Forward resolution to the Committees on Public Safety, REIB, CDNR, and PAC, with a report back by September 14, 2026, passing 7-5.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by Councilor Broderick, seconded by Councilor Bergman, to extend Public Forum and allow ALL speakers to comment... Motion failed: 6:6.
Motion made by Councilor Bergman, seconded by Councilor Litwin, to adopt the consent agenda and take the actions indicated. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Councilor Litwin, seconded by Councilor Schachter, to suspend the rules at 10:36 pm and complete the consent and deliberative agendas... Motion passed: 11:1.
Motion made by Councilor Broderick, seconded by Councilor Singh, to approve the motion as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Councilor Broderick, seconded by Councilor Grant, to approve the motion as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Councilor Broderick, seconded by Councilor Schachter, to approve the motion as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Councilor Bergman, seconded by Councilor Carpenter, to approve the motion as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Councilor Bergman, seconded by Councilor Broderick, to table the resolution... Motion failed: 5:7.
Move to divide the question and separate Article 5, Implementation, Accountability, State Partnership, and Continuing Oversight from the rest of the resolution... Motion failed: 4:8.

Refer the resolution to the Committees on Public Safety, REIB, CDNR, and PAC and request a report back to the full Council on any recommended amendments on items within each committee's jurisdiction by September 14, 2026... Motion passed: 7:5.
